demonstratives.overview: Demonstrative adjectives/pronouns (this/that/these/those) agree in gender and number with the noun they modify or replace.

examples.note: Neuter form - used for unidentified/abstract objects

examples.english: These chairs are made of wood.
That glass is made of glass.

aquel_that_over_there.meaning: that (far from both speaker and listener)
aquel_that_over_there.note: Less commonly drilled in these lessons but follows same pattern: aquel, aquella, aquellos, aquellas, aquello

place_adverbs_pairs.note: These correspond to the three-tier distance system (this/that/that-over-there)

del.example_english: from the car / of the car

al.usage_example: ¿Cuántas tazas de café tomas al día?
al.usage_example_english: How many cups of coffee do you drink per day?

contractions.note: These are the ONLY two mandatory contractions in Spanish. They never uncontract (never say 'a el' or 'de el' for masculine singular 'el').
